title: Deva
desc: Deva and Bharathi are in love and plan on getting married until her father opposes their relationship. Can Deva prove himself to be a worthy suitor?

title: Kochadaiyaan
desc: Rana, a belligerent warrior, declares war against his kingdom's ruler to avenge his father's death, unexpectedly making a new enemy in the process.

title: Meen Kuzhambum Mann Paanaiyum
desc: Annamalai, an overprotective father, is depressed over his son's change of behaviour when he becomes a teenager. Things turn bizarre when they try to sort out their misunderstandings.

title: Pokkiri Raja
desc: Sanjeev loses his job and his girlfriend leaves him due to his massive yawns. Later, he goes to a doctor to get himself cured and learns that he has inherited a superpower from his great-grandfather.

title: Uthama Rasa
desc: Meenu, a bubbly girl, is in love with Chinnaiya, the village leader. Things change when Marudhu, who is the son of Chinnaiya's rival, Parama Thevar, falls for Meenu.
